下がる position/price/temperature lowering and retreat; 下るさがる irregular okurigana versus separate くだる. 下げる transitive hanging/lowering/backing/ table-clearing; not the source's English object-verb comparison dependency.
下りる/降りる same おりる entry and ichidan; spelling preferences not absolute barriers. を in disembarking marks vehicle left, not a manipulated object.

向かう facing versus travelling toward a goal, not already arriving; 向うむかう versus 向こうむこう identities distinct. Source face noun guard explicitly proposed withdrawn with whole-object evidence and pending independent judgment.

進む intransitive movement/progress, not automatic improvement; 移る change of place/affiliation/state, not manner of movement or copying. No lifting appetite/phrase or suffix into unrestricted standalone equivalence.
戻る intransitive return/turn-back versus 戻す putting something back; 帰る can overlap for home return. Russian valency teaches the rule without relying on the single ambiguous English word return.
寄る approach versus short visit and separately attested gathering; no automatic all-motion topic guards. 届ける delivery/formal report versus 届く arrival.
送る dispatch versus accompanying; recipient に, travel limit まで; means of travel unspecified. 迎える receiver role with を versus 会う with に.
連れる taking a person/animal along, 行く/来る direction; not leading a company or winning a race. 逃げる getting away need not imply wrongdoing or running on foot.
遅れる lateness/lag/slow clock, not deliberately delaying an object; 過ぎる passing/elapsed time versus excessive suffix constructions; を route not object.
空く metadata あく and separately taught すく preserved; availability versus reduced crowds/hunger, 開く spelling preference. This is NOT protected033空.
込む independent crowding usually 混む versus independently intricate sense; suffix inward/completion/thoroughness/stay senses do not justify whole-word 入る/入れる/十分/しっかり guards.

引き出す physical drawing out, bank withdrawal and eliciting; source 引出す search-only spelling; all source examples preserved. Actual N4 classification retained when covering N2 source row; no universal retreat/application withdrawal.

揺れる physical sway and figurative wavering; ichidan stem 揺れ, strength not fixed. 滑るすべる godan despite an e-vowel before る, not a literal kana える ending; slipping not necessarily falling, route を. Separate rare writtenぬめる attested, modern necessity/frequency UNVERIFIED.

向ける transitive direction and separate dispatch; 向く physical orientation may take を without forced single valency, separate suitability; neither facing verb is the noun 顔. 対する special する class and に対して/ に対する; not hostility in every relationship or response.

顔 body part/appearance versus 頭 whole head and 表面 general surface; 笑顔えがお full reading. Datedかんばせ noun and がお suffix are not face verbs. Additional person/influence/member safeguards are individually bounded standalone-sense proposals, not universal ordinary quiz equivalences.

下ろす/降ろす sharedおろす entry, godan, not くだす from irregular 下す. Money withdrawal not spelling-restricted; unloading esp.降ろす, not a ban on other shared senses. Every proposed extra pair has own whole-entry basis.
